summary_en: ROE 7.3% (FY3/26, vs. 4.9% prior year), short of 10%+ target. PBR 0.84x, below 1.0x. Dividend policy: 30–40% payout ratio target with DOE focus; FY3/26 dividend 70 yen/share (49.8% payout). Revenue base strengthening, stable shareholder returns, and IR expansion targeted to improve ROE and PBR.
title_en: Response to the Realization of Management Focused on Capital Costs and Stock Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On 15 June 2026, Showa Shinku Co., Ltd. filed an update on its capital-cost and stock-price-conscious management initiative, following a reassessment by the board of directors. The company reported consolidated ROE of 7.3% for FY3/26 (ended 31 March 2026), improving from 4.9% in the prior year but falling short of its 10%+ target. Consolidated PBR improved to 0.84x from 0.71x but remains below 1.0x, attributed to cautious market sentiment on earnings volatility tied to key customers' capital expenditure cycles and insufficient long-term growth expectations. The filing reaffirms commitment to three pillars: (1) revenue base strengthening through high-value vacuum technology in non-quartz/optical-device segments, early customer engagement in next-generation product development, and collaborative R&D with research institutions; (2) stable shareholder returns with a 30–40% dividend payout ratio target and DOE-focused dividend policy—FY3/26 dividend set at 70 yen/share (49.8% payout); (3) enhanced IR activity including expanded non-financial disclosure, bilateral engagement, and brand awareness initiatives. No share buyback program or cancellation is announced in this update.
